metrics.profile_summary: Senior marketing professional with over 12 years of experience in brand management, consumer insights, and strategic communications. Expert in launching brands and executing 360-degree marketing plans across retail, building materials, and financial sectors.

education.degree: Masters of Business Administration (Marketing and Advertising)

experience.description: Leads all marketing and brand promotion, including media management, event planning, and budget oversight.
Managed brand promotion, media, and communications, including the management of the Karachi Design Studio.
Developed 360-degree marketing plans and digital strategies to amplify brand outreach on social media.
Handled promotional planning, dealership network management, and market analysis for export and local markets.
Managed dealership networks in the South region and implemented market sizing programs.
Managed qualitative and quantitative research projects for FMCG, telecom, and banking clients.

strengths: Extensive brand management and strategic leadership experience
Strong academic credentials with an MBA in Marketing
Proven track record of successful brand launches
weaknesses: Significantly overqualified for a coordinator-level role
Lacks explicit mention of tactical tools like Canva or Meta Business Suite
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly experienced marketing leader who far exceeds the minimum experience and education requirements. While capable of performing the tasks, his seniority suggests he may be overqualified for the tactical execution focus of this role.
